agree.title: Agree
agree.text: Person: real text, too small. System: blocked. Both say send it back.

policy.title: Policy question
policy.text: Person: garbled or decorative. System: blocked. Whether AI lettering must be readable is a product decision, not a measurement.

false_positive.title: System false positive

unresolved.title: Unresolved

flipped.title: Flipped
flipped.text: Shown twice, unannounced. The person gave different answers.

control.title: Control
control.text: A caption we injected below the minimum. The right answer is known: real text, too small.
